label: Deployed reference — unchanged baseline

methods.publicHttp: Five sequential fetches per target, 200 ms spacing, 20 s timeout, no-store client requests; CDN/network connection reuse uncontrolled.
methods.bodyBytes: Decoded response bytes, not compressed wire transfer size.
methods.synthetic: Unmodified authentication and direct adapter functions in isolated VM; every fetch is an in-memory fixture; uniform simulated delay per fetch; three repetitions per case.
methods.timing: Synthetic elapsed starts before fresh auth proof and ends on terminal result; excludes login, human deliberation, browser transport, Worker API, storage, queueing, and real server work.
methods.tests: Complete unchanged Worker suite; both isolated headless Chromium guard and SSO fixtures enabled with loopback-only traffic.

limitations: No live login or enrollment benchmark. No real Book, Drop, account access, or private course selection performed.
No rush-load, concurrency-load, availability, capacity, or end-to-end user latency claim.
Small single-client samples; min/median/max are descriptive, not percentile estimates or guarantees.
Synthetic delays and response shapes demonstrate dependency ordering only; they do not predict institutional server performance.
Synthetic times include Node timer scheduling and a 2 ms requested status-poll interval; especially at zero injected delay, they are not isolated adapter CPU timings.
The synthetic adapter selects one existing allowlist identity internally; all course/route/account identifiers are omitted from the report.

Public HTML, linked script and stylesheet bytes match the supplied local build; health confirms only endpoint availability. Private Worker source identity is not established by public byte comparison.

publicHttp.discardReason: Initial HTTP samples were not saved before a local synthetic-fixture constructor error; one complete sampling pass was repeated.
